messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: P0 — Elevated 5xx rate and request drops observed for customer Elysian in their dedicated VPC canary pool (elysian-prod-canary). Started ~2026-03-14T20:12:00Z. Alert: error-rate > 15% for 5m. Link: https://redwood.monitoring/incidents/2987654321 :rotating_light:
oncall-maria: Ack. I’m on it. Rough ETA 15m to triage unless someone local can jump in faster.
ashley-sre: Maria — can you confirm customer-visible impact? Is traffic failing for all tenants or only canary subset?
leo-runtime: Jumping in — quick summary: the canary instances are hitting an OOM+KV-cache miss pattern after the recent artifact promotion. Pool: elysian-prod-canary on node-group dkt-7. Artifact promoted earlier today: build-2026-03-14-0a9f.
kai-ops: Logs snippet (from dkt-7 bundle):
```
2026-03-14T20:10:32Z elysian-prod-canary instance-5 runtime ERROR kv_cache: eviction spike, free_mem=120MB
2026-03-14T20:10:33Z elysian-prod-canary instance-7 runtime ERROR OOM at attention_kernel.c:424
2026-03-14T20:10:34Z elysian-prod-canary instance-3 proxy WARN upstream 502
```
ravi-cs: Customer Elysian support pinged us via SSO channel — they report degraded inference quality and timeouts for canary traffic; production (non-canary) still mostly healthy. They want a status update.
ashley-sre: Thanks. So this is limited to the canary pool. Prior version has been stable. Recommend reverting canary to previous pinned artifact to stop customer impact while we investigate root cause.
leo-runtime: Agreed. Previous pinned artifact: build-2026-03-10-1b2c. Runtime note: the new artifact introduced a kernel change that increases KV memory footprint under certain sequence distributions. Quick rollback should stabilize.
oncall-maria: Ok planning steps: 1) Notify Elysian CS that we’re performing a canary rollback and will follow with a postmortem; 2) Pin canary pool to the prior artifact and force immediate recycle of canary instances; 3) Monitor error-rate and latency; 4) If stable, extend pin to reserved pool.
pm-sanjay: I’ll draft the customer note, keep it transparent: say we’re rolling canary back to prior verified artifact to reduce impact.
leo-runtime: deploy steps (will run with @deploy-bot):
```
# pin artifact
redwoodctl pools set-artifact --pool elysian-prod-canary --artifact build-2026-03-10-1b2c --pin
# recycle canary instances
redwoodctl pools recycle --pool elysian-prod-canary --grace 30s
```
deploy-bot: Received command, executing in sequence. Will report progress.
ashley-sre: Maria, handoff suggestion: I’ll stay on for runtime/monitoring while Marcus (next oncall) takes ownership of customer comms after you. We should do a brief SLO check-in after rollback.
oncall-maria: Sounds good. Marcus — you up? (cc @pm-sanjay)
(oncall-marcus not in thread)
leo-runtime: deploy-bot live update: step1 pin succeeded: artifact build-2026-03-10-1b2c pinned to elysian-prod-canary by deploy-bot at 2026-03-14T20:24:12Z.
deploy-bot: recycle jobs submitted: 6 instances scheduling graceful shutdown. Approx 90s per instance to warm.
kai-ops: Watchpoints: ensure KV cache warmup on new instances; we should temporarily reduce canary concurrency to 50% to avoid load spike on warmup. Command: `redwoodctl pools set-config --pool elysian-prod-canary --concurrency-percent 50`
leo-runtime: Done. Reducing canary concurrency to 50%.
ravi-cs: Sent initial customer message: "We are rolling the canary back to a previously verified runtime artifact to mitigate observed errors. We’ll update when stable."
pm-sanjay: Customer reply: appreciated, asks for ETA ~20-30m.
kai-ops: Metrics: error-rate dropping — current 5xx at 6% (was 18%), p95 latency improving. Still watching.
ashley-sre: Good sign. Keep an eye for any leftover 502s from proxies; those can be transient.
leo-runtime: Confirming: after canary recovery we’ll run a targeted canary that exercises long sequences to validate KV memory behavior before we consider re-promoting. Also will open a kernel regression ticket.
oncall-maria: Handoff: I’m done for my shift — Marcus will take post-rollback monitoring and follow-up. Marcus please ack when you pick up.
pm-sanjay: Draft post for the incident channel and customer-facing SR created (SR-9221).
leo-runtime: deploy-bot: recycle complete. All canary instances on build-2026-03-10-1b2c and healthchecks passing.
deploy-bot: Canary health summary: 6/6 healthy, 5xx rate 1.4%, p95 latency normal.
ashley-sre: Nice. Recommend closing active paging but keep on-call watch for 2 hours.
pm-sanjay: Customer replied: "Thanks — service normal for the moment, please keep us posted."
oncall-maria: Closing note to timeline: root-cause investigation to follow, temporary mitigation applied (canary pinned to previous artifact), customer notified, CS SR created. Marking status: mitigated.
incident-bot: Incident update: status=mitigated, severity=P0 -> P1, page closed. Incident timeline: https://redwood.incidents/2987654321/summary
leo-runtime: I’ll file the kernel regression issue with reproduction steps and attach traces.
ashley-sre: Good job team. I’ll start the postmortem doc and link to SR-9221.
deploy-bot: Final: rollback confirmed, monitoring on reduced concurrency, no further action required unless errors resurface.
